generationInputs.prompt:
A humorous vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, showcases a stylized donut, an eggplant, and a viscous liquid amidst a foggy, dark background with glittering diamonds. The poster, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, features a large, bold headline arching across the top in all caps: "THIS IS MY JAM... AND MY JELLY... AND MY DONUT."

In the center, a luminous, almost ethereal pink donut, appearing weightless with a dreamlike, holographic icing, is depicted. Viscous liquid chocolate drips from the donut, and a small pinkish-red flower rests upon it. Tiny, brightly colored, almost translucent sprinkles are scattered across the icing, adding a delicate sparkle. Beside it, an eggplant holds a syringe, and a viscous, shiny white liquid is present. These elements are rendered as stylized, engraved illustrations, subtly adapting to the cream background and red-toned palette. The background features a thick fog, with bright, sparkling diamonds scattered across the ground, all conforming to the vintage aesthetic. The overall impression is one of witty elegance and slightly otherworldly charm.
